nodes.name: output-header
annotations:
Data:      the readout line — the seat's own status, and the usage figures it is handed: tokens, calls
Source:    the seat's conversation; the usage arrives as the surface's own binding, never another scope's totals
State:     always drawn — the leading panel of the output area; sticky, never removed
A11y:      role="status"
Connects:  the model mark at the trailing edge (model-readout-tokens-etc) names the model in play; the gripper (gripper-prompt-input-chat-menu) resizes this panel against the one below
Builder:   leads the stack and takes 20px of top padding; every panel under it takes 6
Failure:   a seat that cannot resolve its own conversation reads "unattributed" rather than showing another scope's numbers

State: sticky — the leading panel is always present; never removed, never moved
Disabled: no action — nothing on this panel responds to a click

_amendments.what: The results card frame was renamed in Figma: 'chat-output-header' #40001119:6327 -> 'chat-output-area-results' #40001130:5060 (new node id). REST facts for the new frame: fill rgba(117,142,135,0.35), stroke rgba(117,142,135,0.5), radius 8, pad 2/10/10/10. The pre-rename card #40001119:6327 now carries the owner's light fill #F8FFF9.
_amendments.why: One Figma name covered two shapes (the bar and the results card); the catalog/registry conflated them. The association is fixed in src/components/registry.json.
